items.t: Anthropic makes record stock market debut
items.d: Anthropic's $81bn IPO, the biggest ever, priced at $83 a share. ANT opened 34% higher on Nasdaq but faded to close up 17% at $97.17.

items.t: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen at APEC
items.d: The three leaders held a rare 90-minute meeting at the APEC summit. They pledged more oil and gas output and said no one can win a nuclear war, but little concrete was agreed.

items.t: Burnham ready to walk away before EU summit
items.d: Ahead of today's UK-EU summit in Brussels, the PM said he would quit a deal not in Britain's interest. The UK has reportedly accepted 100,000 youth visas a year; EU food rules remain the sticking point.

items.t: Senate Republicans block bid to end Iran war
items.d: The Senate again rejected a Democratic war powers resolution to end US involvement in the Iran war, with no new Republican support despite the party's election losses.

items.t: Trump 'not rushing' on Iran as war costs top $48bn
items.d: Trump said he may wait until the new year to decide next steps. Iran claimed two more tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz, and the Pentagon put the war's cost above $48bn.

items.t: Putin rules out direct talks with Ukraine
items.d: After a Ukrainian strike on the Kerch bridge in Crimea, Putin said at APEC there would be no direct negotiations with Kyiv, dimming hopes for a peace push.

items.t: Wall Street slides as AI trade wobbles
items.d: The Dow fell 1,101 points (2.2%) to below 50,000 and the Nasdaq lost 2.25%. Chip stocks led losses; AMD dropped about 8% after a short seller targeted it.

items.t: Walmart beats forecasts and lifts outlook
items.d: Walmart's quarterly revenue reached $188.8bn, ahead of expectations, with US same-store sales up 2.9% and online sales up 17%. It raised its full-year forecast.

items.t: Moody's cuts Nvidia outlook after CEO exit
items.d: Moody's lowered Nvidia's credit outlook to stable from positive, citing no formal succession plan after Jensen Huang's sudden departure.

items.t: Nvidia stops shipping H200 AI chips to China
items.d: Despite US approval for some sales, Nvidia says it plans no more licensed Hopper shipments to China, after $2.4bn in China sales last quarter.

items.t: Nvidia's interim CEO rallies staff
items.d: Colette Kress held her first all-hands after Jensen Huang's exit, reportedly promising pay rises and extra equity before December to keep staff.

items.t: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon
items.d: Google's new model targets coding and complex analysis, with a 1-million-token context window. It is rolling out via the API and to Gemini subscribers.

items.t: Banks say AI agent users are on their own
items.d: Citi and other banks now make customers liable for transactions made by third-party AI assistants with account access, even if the tools are hacked.

items.t: Big US school districts weigh dropping Google
items.d: New York, Los Angeles and Chicago schools are looking at alternatives after Google said schools cannot switch off Gemini AI features in Search from next year.

items.t: OpenAI uses its own AI to design chips
items.d: OpenAI says model-suggested changes shrank one chip circuit by about 15% and halved a calculation's clock cycles. It is working with Synopsys on AI design tools.

items.t: Blood test may spot CTE in living people
items.d: A JAMA study of 21 former American football players found a tau marker in blood was higher in those with severe CTE, a brain disease until now only confirmed after death.

items.t: Clue to why type 1 diabetes attack persists
items.d: University of Florida scientists found self-renewing, stem-like T cells near the pancreas that may keep the immune attack going, a possible new drug target.

items.t: Night shifts linked to heart structure changes
items.d: A UK Biobank study of 42,671 people found frequent night-shift workers had slightly thicker heart walls and smaller chambers, though pumping strength was similar.

items.t: Inflation edges up to 3.6% as diesel hits record
items.d: CPI rose to 3.6% in October from 3.5%, driven by fuel. Diesel averaged 199.5p a litre, the highest since records began in 1996.

items.t: Polls show most Britons now back rejoining EU
items.d: As Burnham heads to Brussels, a YouGov poll found 59% would back rejoining. He has ruled out big changes before the next election but plans wider talks.

items.t: Anthropic上市創紀錄
items.d: Anthropic以每股83美元招股，集資約810億美元，為史上最大型IPO。股份（ANT）在納斯達克首日高開34%，其後回落，收市仍升17%報97.17美元。

items.t: 特朗普、習近平、普京深圳APEC會面
items.d: 三國領袖在亞太經合組織峰會期間罕有會面約90分鐘，承諾增加石油及天然氣產量，並重申核戰沒有贏家，但未有具體成果。

items.t: 英歐峰會前夕 賓咸稱準備放棄協議
items.d: 今日在布魯塞爾舉行英歐峰會前，首相賓咸表示若協議不符英國利益會放棄。英方據報已接受每年10萬個青年工作簽證，歐盟食品規例仍是癥結。

items.t: 美參院共和黨再阻終結伊朗戰爭決議
items.d: 參議院再次否決民主黨提出、要求美國結束參與伊朗戰爭的戰爭權力決議。共和黨在選舉失利後仍無新增議員支持。

items.t: 特朗普稱不急於對伊朗決策 戰費逾480億
items.d: 特朗普表示或待明年才決定下一步。伊朗稱再有兩艘油輪在荷姆茲海峽觸雷，五角大樓指戰爭開支已超過480億美元。

items.t: 普京排除與烏克蘭直接談判
items.d: 烏克蘭襲擊克里米亞刻赤大橋後，普京在APEC期間表示不會與基輔直接談判，令和談前景更黯淡。

items.t: AI股受壓 華爾街急跌
items.d: 道指跌1,101點（2.2%），失守50,000點；納指跌2.25%。晶片股領跌，AMD遭沽空機構狙擊後跌約8%。

items.t: Walmart業績勝預期並上調展望
items.d: Walmart季度收入達1,888億美元，高於預期；美國同店銷售升2.9%，網購升17%，並上調全年預測。

items.t: 穆迪下調Nvidia評級展望
items.d: 黃仁勳突然離任後，Nvidia未有正式接班計劃，穆迪將其信貸評級展望由「正面」降至「穩定」。

items.t: Nvidia停止向中國付運H200晶片
items.d: 雖然美國已批准部分銷售，Nvidia表示不再計劃向中國付運獲許可的Hopper晶片；上季中國銷售額為24億美元。

items.t: Nvidia署理行政總裁安撫員工
items.d: 黃仁勳離任後，Colette Kress首次舉行全體員工大會，據報承諾12月前加薪及增發股份以挽留人才。

items.t: Google推出Gemini 4 Neon
items.d: Google新模型主打編程及複雜分析，支援100萬token上下文，正透過API及向Gemini訂戶推出。

items.t: 銀行：用AI代理交易風險自負
items.d: Citi等銀行修訂條款，客戶授權第三方AI助理操作帳戶所作交易，即使工具被入侵，責任亦由客戶承擔。

items.t: 美國大型學區考慮棄用Google
items.d: Google表示學校明年起不能關閉搜尋中的Gemini AI功能，紐約、洛杉磯及芝加哥學區正研究其他選擇。

items.t: OpenAI用自家AI設計晶片
items.d: OpenAI表示，模型建議的修改令一個晶片電路面積縮小約15%，並把一項運算由兩個時鐘週期減至一個；亦與Synopsys合作開發AI設計工具。

items.t: 驗血或可診斷在世者CTE
items.d: 《美國醫學會雜誌》研究分析21名前美式足球員，發現血液中一種tau標記在嚴重CTE患者中較高；此腦病過往只能死後確診。

items.t: 揭示一型糖尿病免疫攻擊持續之謎
items.d: 佛羅里達大學發現胰臟附近有能自我更新的幹細胞樣T細胞，可能令免疫攻擊持續，或成新藥目標。

items.t: 夜班工作與心臟結構變化有關
items.d: 英國生物樣本庫42,671人研究發現，經常上夜班者心壁略厚、心腔略小，但泵血能力相若。

items.t: 通脹升至3.6% 柴油價創紀錄
items.d: 10月消費物價指數由3.5%升至3.6%，主要受燃油推動。柴油平均每公升199.5便士，創1996年有紀錄以來新高。

items.t: 民調：多數英國人支持重返歐盟
items.d: 賓咸赴布魯塞爾之際，YouGov民調顯示59%人支持重新加入歐盟。他已排除下屆大選前作重大改變，但計劃展開更廣泛磋商。
